creatorAnalysis.title: Falanqaynta fiidyowga abuuraha
creatorAnalysis.description: Wuxuu falanqeeyaa fiidyowyada qoraaga ee la soo shubay iyada oo loo eegayo qaybinta waxqabadka, isbeddelka dhowaan, muddada, qaabka, calaamadaha cinwaanka, iyo tayada ka-qaybgalka.
creatorAnalysis.loadAllHint: Falanqaynta hadda waxay isticmaashaa waxyaabaha la soo shubay. Soo shub dhammaan fiidyowyada si aad u hesho gabagabo heer-akooneed; tani waxay wici kartaa codsiyo API oo badan oo la kala qaybiyey.
creatorAnalysis.insightDepth: Kaydinta/qoto-dheerida lacagta qadaadiicda ah waa mid macno leh, sidaa darteed casharrada, adeegyada, ama qiimaha dib-u-daawashada waa in laga soocaa gaadhista saafiga ah.
creatorAnalysis.insightConversation: Hawsha faallooyinka/wadaagista waa mid macno leh, sidaa darteed doodaha, aqoonsiga, ama dhiirigelinta bulshada ayaa qayb ka ah mashiinka waxqabadka.

report.methodologyBody: Warbixintan waxaa soo ururiyay TikHub Analytics Studio oo ka yimid API-yada madal dadweynaha iyo TikHub DataSet. Cabbirrada waxaa la ururiyaa wakhtiga la abuurayo warbixinta waxaana laga yaabaa inay isbedelaan marka ay waxyaabaha hoose isbedelaan. Qaybaha ku shaqeeya AI (falanqaynta fayraska, soo saarista degdegga ah) waxaa soo saara LLM-ka awoodda aragga leh ee la habeeyay waxaana loo tixgelinayaa inay yihiin talooyin falanqayn ah halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen runta dhabta ah.
report.disclaimerBody: Dhammaan xogta waxay leedahay milkiilayaasha xuquuqda asalka ah waxaana halkan lagu soo saaray ujeedooyin falanqayn oo keliya. TikHub Analytics Studio ma bixinayso wax dammaanad ah oo ku saabsan dhammaystirka ama saxnaanta mana qaadanayso wax mas'uuliyad ah go'aannada lagu gaaro warbixintan. Dib-u-qaybinta ka baxsan qaataha loogu talagalay waa mamnuuc.
